body.title: Shared pan/zoom runtime asset
body.summary: Add src/assets/artifacts/companion/panzoom.js: a dependency-free, transform-based pan/zoom bound to a view panel and toolbar (zoom out, zoom %, zoom in, Fit, 1:1), with drag-pan, wheel zoom at the cursor, double-click zoom and an exposed fit() for fit-on-load. Works on any child (SVG or HTML).
acceptanceChecks: The script has no external references and is shipped by copy-assets (src/assets is copied wholesale).
It exposes an init entry the shell can call with the panel/stage/toolbar ids and a fit() hook.

tests.name: panzoom asset: no http(s)/import references; exposes init + fit entry points
headless Chrome: each generated page draws, fit-on-load applied, no console error
